name: Kanuma (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kanuma city emblem in white: a six-pointed star bearing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kanuma, a city in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1948.

features.role: Kanuma city emblem — a six-pointed star bearing a stylised character
